evidence_interpretation.narrative: Binary change on the unchanged v0.4.8 argument set (--max-private-continuations 8 --device-state-slots 4 --host-state-slots 24): runtime source d956e6d6 on branch feat/warm-arrival carries three context-cache fixes (a fork inherits the anchor it forks from; consuming an endpoint no longer double-charges a shared anchor; a full anchor set replaces the least valuable anchor instead of the earliest) and the restore path change (payloads hashed once as the engine streams them, x86 SHA extensions, queue-depth-eight io_uring reads overlapped with the hash). Every gate below was measured on 2026-09-08 against a candidate container running the appliance-local build 71edc2f6 with the v0.4.8 arguments; the candidate was started by the same docker run shape the lifecycle uses but not through tools/lifecycle/ninfer_container.py, so the configuration identity under the release profile name is computed at staging. Nothing is inherited except the store-format authority and the origin-authentication arc.
